full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic headshot shows an older man against a nearly black background. His face occupies the central portion of the frame, from the shadowed hairline near the top to a short pale beard near the lower edge. Loose dark curls spill around the left side and across his forehead, partly obscuring the brow. He faces the camera directly with heavy-lidded eyes and a restrained, unsmiling expression. Dark shadows gather beneath the eyes and along the right side of his face, while a broad pale light catches the forehead, nose, cheeks, and beard. A small moustache and uneven stubble surround the mouth; the lighter beard at the chin stands out against his dark clothing. His shoulders form low sloping black shapes at the bottom corners, with little separation from the background. The face is not polished smooth: pores, wrinkles, grain, and slight photographic softness remain visible across the lit skin. The background has almost no spatial clue, holding only subtle tonal variation around the hair. The composition is tightly centered and leaves a dark band above the head, which makes the pale facial planes appear lower and more weighted. Light seems to arrive from the upper image left and somewhat in front, falling strongly on one cheek and fading across the other. Fine gray values keep the eyes, nose, and beard readable inside the high contrast. The overall image is direct and somber, using compressed space, natural surface detail, and deep shadow to hold attention on the still gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白摄影头像呈现一位年长男子，背景近乎全黑。面孔占据中央，从靠近上方的暗发际到下缘附近的浅色短胡须。松散深卷发散在左侧并落过额头，部分挡住眉毛。他正面面对镜头，眼睑沉重，表情克制而不笑。暗影聚在眼下及画面右侧脸部，宽阔浅光则照亮额头、鼻子、双颊和胡须。小胡子与不均匀胡茬围住嘴巴，下巴较浅的胡须在深衣服前显得突出。肩膀在下角形成低斜的黑色形体，几乎与背景分不开。脸没有被修饰得平滑：受光皮肤上保留毛孔、皱纹、颗粒和轻微摄影柔化。背景几乎没有空间线索，仅在头发周围有细微明暗变化。构图紧紧居中，头顶留下一道深色区域，使浅色面部平面显得位置更低、更有分量。光似乎从画面左上稍靠前处到来，较强地落在一侧面颊，再向另一侧渐弱。细密灰阶让双眼、鼻子和胡须在高反差中仍可辨认。整体画面直接而沉郁，以压缩空间、自然表面细节和深影把注意力留在静止的目光上。
style_prompt_en: The image has a direct monochrome photographic treatment, with dense black surrounding a compact center of mottled silver midtones. Grain, pores, and slight optical softness remain part of the surface, while a few illuminated edges keep the focal form distinct. Dark irregular strands break into the background without a clean cutout, and lower shapes merge almost completely with the shadow. Frontal but slightly offset light brings out raised planes and then fades across recessed areas. A generous dark margin above the dense center gives the square a weighted, quiet arrangement. The overall effect is austere and somber, grounded in natural texture rather than decorative finish.
style_prompt_zh: 画面采用直接的单色摄影处理，浓黑包围着由斑驳银灰中间调组成的紧凑中心。颗粒、毛孔和轻微光学柔化保留在表面中，少数受光边缘仍把焦点形体清楚分出。不规则深色丝线与背景交错，没有干净的剪贴边；下部形体几乎全融入阴影。正面但稍有偏移的光抬亮凸面，随后在凹处逐渐减弱。密集中心上方充足的深色留白使方形布局有分量且安静。整体效果简峻而沉郁，依托自然肌理而非装饰性完成面。
theme_en: A grainy black-and-white headshot of a disheveled older man against darkness
theme_zh: 凌乱头发的年长男子在黑暗前的颗粒黑白头像
name: Kim Ki-Duk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
